# g18 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 9
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 10 for i = 1, ..., 9

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = - 0.5 \sum_{i=1}^9 x_i (1 + \cos(2 \pi x_i))
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = \sum_{i=1}^9 x_i - 1 \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = \prod_{i=1}^9 x_i - 0.75 \leq 0
```
```math
g_3(x) = \sum_{i=1}^9 x_i^2 - 7.5 \leq 0
```
... (additional constraints as per original)

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = -0.866025
